The Guiana Space Centre has two service stations on its site. These two stations are strategically located at two points: at the entrance to the CSG site, at the Technical Centre site, and the other at the Ensemble de Lancement 3 area. These two stations currently distribute both Diesel and SP95 fuel for passenger vehicles (VL), as well as for trucks and operational machinery.

In order to consolidate and maintain operational service, we need to fully renovate both infrastructures.

The combined fuel volumes per station amount to 350m3/year.
